recursive_loss_failure_modes.description: Failure modes associated with the recursive accumulation of information loss.

failure_modes.name: reconstruction_horizon_collapse
failure_modes.description: Recursive loss accumulates faster than dissipation, erasing all local causal links.

failure_modes.name: unstable_loss_divergence
failure_modes.description: Information loss grows exponentially due to resonance in recursive transport cycles.

failure_modes.name: selection_induced_history_erasure
failure_modes.description: Iterative selection of a single branch permanently discards valid alternative histories.

failure_modes.name: epsilon_boundary_loss_spike
failure_modes.description: Small perturbations near epsilon=0 result in large-scale information collapse under projection.
